en.s: The Battle of Langshan Jiang, or the Battle of Langshan River (Chinese: 狼山江之戰; lit. 'Battle of Wolf Mountain River'), was a riverine battle which occurred in 919 during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period in China between the dynastic states of Wuyue and Yang Wu.

zh.s: 狼山江之战也称狼山河之战，发生于中国五代十国时期的919年，是吴越与杨吴两个政权之间的一场水战。

en.t: Alberic II of Spoleto arranges the election of pope Agapetus II following the death of Pope Marinus II
en.s: Alberic II (died 954) was princeps of Rome from 932 to 954. He controlled the papacy during his reign and the five popes after Pope John XI were appointed by him. A member of the House of Theophylact, Alberic was the father of Pope John XII and multiple other popes were descended from Alberic.

zh.t: 斯波莱托的阿尔贝里克二世安排阿加佩图斯二世当选教皇，接替去世的马里努斯二世
zh.s: 阿尔贝里克二世（卒于 954 年）自 932 至 954 年任罗马亲王。他在统治期间控制教廷；教皇约翰十一世之后的五位教皇均由他任命。他是狄奥菲拉克特家族成员，也是教皇约翰十二世的父亲，另有多位后世教皇是他的后代。

en.t: Scottish nobles recognize the authority of Edward I of England pending the selection of a king
en.s: Edward I (17/18 June 1239 – 7 July 1307), also known as Edward Longshanks and the Hammer of the Scots (Latin: Malleus Scotorum), was King of England from 1272 to 1307. Concurrently, he was Lord of Ireland, and from 1254 to 1306 ruled Gascony as Duke of Aquitaine in his capacity as a vassal of the French king.

zh.t: 苏格兰贵族承认英格兰国王爱德华一世的权威，等待选出国王
zh.s: 爱德华一世（1239 年 6 月 17 日或 18 日—1307 年 7 月 7 日）又称“长腿爱德华”和“苏格兰之锤”，1272 至 1307 年任英格兰国王。他同时是爱尔兰领主，并于 1254 至 1306 年以法国国王封臣的身份任阿基坦公爵、统治加斯科涅。

en.t: Temür, Khagan of the Mongols, is enthroned as Emperor of the Yuan dynasty
en.s: The Yuan dynasty, officially the Great Yuan, was a Mongol-led imperial dynasty of China and a successor state to the Mongol Empire after its division. It was established by Kublai (Emperor Shizu or Setsen Khan), the fifth khagan-emperor of the Mongol Empire from the Borjigin clan, and lasted from 1271 to 1368 CE. In Chinese history, the Yuan dynasty followed the Song dynasty and preceded the Ming dynasty.

zh.t: 蒙古大汗帖木儿登基，成为元朝皇帝
zh.s: 元朝正式国号为大元，是由蒙古人建立的中国王朝，也是蒙古帝国分裂后的继承政权。元朝由忽必烈（元世祖或薛禅汗）建立；他是孛儿只斤氏成员，也是蒙古帝国第五位大汗兼皇帝。元朝于 1271 年建立，1368 年灭亡。在中国历史上，元朝承接宋朝，之后由明朝取代。

en.s: Öljeyitü Khan (Mongolian: Өлзийт Хаан; Mongolian script: ᠥᠯᠵᠡᠶᠢᠲᠦ Öljeyitü; Chinese: 完澤篤汗), born Temür (Mongolian: Төмөр ᠲᠡᠮᠦᠷ; Chinese: 鐵穆耳; 15 October 1265 – 10 February 1307), also known by his temple name as the Emperor Chengzong of Yuan (Chinese: 元成宗; pinyin: Yuán Chéngzōng; Wade–Giles: Yüan2 Ch'eng2-tsung1), was the second emperor of the Yuan dynasty of China, ruling from 10 May 1294 to 10 February 1307.

zh.s: 完泽笃汗（蒙古语：Өлзийт Хаан，蒙古文：ᠥᠯᠵᠡᠶᠢᠲᠦ；汉名铁穆耳，1265年10月15日—1307年2月10日）是元朝第二位皇帝，庙号元成宗。他于1294年5月10日登基，在位至1307年2月10日。

en.s: The Battle of Loudoun Hill was fought on 10 May 1307, between a Scots force led by King Robert the Bruce and the English commanded by Aymer de Valence, Earl of Pembroke. It took place beneath Loudoun Hill, in Ayrshire, and ended in a victory for King Robert. It was the king's first major military victory. The battlefield was added to the Inventory of Historic Battlefields in Scotland in 2012.

zh.s: 卢登山战役于1307年5月10日爆发，交战双方是罗伯特·布鲁斯国王率领的苏格兰军队和彭布罗克伯爵艾默·德·瓦朗斯率领的英格兰军队。战斗在艾尔郡卢登山脚下进行，最终由罗伯特国王获胜，这是他取得的首场重大军事胜利。2012年，这处战场被列入苏格兰历史战场名录。

en.s: The Battle of Dysert O'Dea took place on 10 May 1318 at Dysert O'Dea near Corofin, Ireland. It was part of the Bruce campaign in Ireland. The Norman Richard de Clare attacked the Gaelic Irish chieftain Conchobhar Ó Deághaidh, chief of the Cineal Fearmaic and ally of Muirchertach Ó Briain, but he was defeated.

zh.s: 1318年5月10日，迪瑟特奥迪战役在爱尔兰科罗芬附近的迪瑟特奥迪发生，是布鲁斯远征爱尔兰的一部分。诺曼人理查德·德·克莱尔进攻盖尔爱尔兰酋长康乔巴尔·奥德亚赫。后者是费尔马克家族首领，也是穆尔赫塔赫·奥布莱恩的盟友。德·克莱尔战败。

en.s: The Battle of Casaloldo was fought on 10 May 1509 at Casaloldo (Lombardy) between the armies of the Marquisate of Mantua and that of Republic of Venice, an episode of the War of the League of Cambrai.

zh.s: 卡萨洛尔多战役于1509年5月10日在伦巴第的卡萨洛尔多爆发，交战双方是曼托瓦侯国和威尼斯共和国的军队。这场战役是康布雷同盟战争中的一次战斗。

en.s: Battle of Akatsuka (or Akazuka, May 10, 1552) was the first recorded battle of the young Oda Nobunaga in his struggle to unite the province of Owari, against one of the former vassals of his late father (Oda Nobuhide, died in 1551), who switched his allegiance to the powerful Imagawa clan of Suruga province.

zh.s: 赤冢之战（又称赤塚之战）发生于1552年5月10日，是织田信长在统一尾张国的斗争中首次有记录的战斗。对手是他已故父亲织田信秀（1551年去世）的一名前家臣；此人转而效忠势力强大的骏河国今川氏。

en.s: The Battle of Macroom was a skirmish fought on 10 May 1650, near Macroom, County Cork, in southern Ireland, during the Cromwellian conquest of Ireland. An English Parliamentarian force under Roger Boyle, (Lord Broghill), defeated an Irish Confederate force under David Roche.

zh.s: 麦克鲁姆战役是一次小规模冲突，发生于1650年5月10日，地点在爱尔兰南部科克郡麦克鲁姆附近，属于克伦威尔征服爱尔兰战争的一部分。罗杰·博伊尔（布罗希尔勋爵）率领的英国议会军击败了戴维·罗奇率领的爱尔兰邦联军。

en.t: King Narai nominates Phetracha as regent, leading to the revolution of 1688 in which Phetracha becomes king of the Ayutthaya Kingdom
en.s: The Siamese revolution of 1688 was a major popular uprising in the Siamese Ayutthaya Kingdom (modern Thailand) which led to the overthrow of the pro-French Siamese king Narai. Phetracha, previously one of Narai's trusted military advisors, took advantage of the elderly Narai's illness, and killed Narai's Christian heir, along with a number of missionaries and Narai's influential foreign minister, the Greek adventurer Constantine Phaulkon.

zh.t: 那莱王任命佩特拉差为摄政王，促成1688年暹罗革命，佩特拉差随后成为阿瑜陀耶王国国王
zh.s: 1688年暹罗革命是阿瑜陀耶王国的一场重大民众起义，推翻了亲法的那莱王。佩特拉差曾是那莱王信任的军事顾问，他趁年迈的那莱王患病，杀死了那莱的基督徒继承人、多名传教士，以及那莱重用的希腊裔外交大臣康斯坦丁·法尔孔。

en.s: The Battle of Pilsud was fought between Sawai Jai Singh and the Marathas under Kanhoji Bhonsle and Khanderao Dabhade.

zh.s: 1715年，萨瓦伊·贾伊·辛格与马拉塔军队爆发皮尔苏德之战。马拉塔军由卡诺吉·邦斯勒和坎德拉奥·达巴德率领。

en.s: The Capture of Eilean Donan Castle was a land-based naval engagement that took place in 1719 during the British Jacobite rising of that year, and the War of the Quadruple Alliance. A British naval reconnaissance force of three ships attacked the castle of Eilean Donan on the west coast of Scotland, which was held by Spanish troops. After a naval bombardment, the British government forces stormed the castle, and the defenders surrendered.

zh.s: 1719年，在詹姆斯党起义和四国同盟战争期间，英国海军侦察队与西班牙守军在苏格兰西海岸的艾琳多南城堡交战。英国舰队出动三艘船，先以舰炮轰击城堡，随后政府军攻入，守军投降。

en.s: The Parliament of Great Britain was formed in May 1707 following the ratification of the Acts of Union by both the Parliament of England and the Parliament of Scotland. The Acts ratified the treaty of Union which created a new unified Kingdom of Great Britain and created the parliament of Great Britain located in the former home of the English parliament in the Palace of Westminster, near the City of London.
en.n: The Parliament of Great Britain passes the Tea Act, designed to save the British East India Company by reducing taxes on its tea and granting it the right to sell tea directly to North America. The legislation leads to the Boston Tea Party.

zh.s: 1707年，英格兰议会和苏格兰议会分别批准《联合法案》，大不列颠议会由此成立。两项法案批准了《联合法案条约》，建立统一的大不列颠王国，并在威斯敏斯特宫原英格兰议会所在地设立大不列颠议会，位置靠近伦敦城。
zh.n: 大不列颠议会通过《茶叶法案》，通过降低茶叶税并允许英国东印度公司直接向北美销售茶叶，试图挽救该公司。这项法案后来引发了波士顿倾茶事件。

en.s: The Capture of Fort Ticonderoga occurred during the American Revolutionary War on May 10, 1775, when a small force of Green Mountain Boys led by Ethan Allen and Colonel Benedict Arnold overcame a small British garrison at the fort and looted the personal belongings of the garrison. Cannons and other armaments from the fort were later transported to Boston and used to fortify Dorchester Heights and break the standoff at the Siege of Boston. After seizing Ticonderoga, a small detachment captured the nearby Fort Crown Point on May 11.

zh.s: 1775年5月10日，美国独立战争期间，以伊森·艾伦和本尼迪克特·阿诺德上校为首的一小队绿山男孩民兵攻占了提康德罗加堡，击败人数不多的英军守军，并掠走守军的私人物品。后来，堡内的大炮和其他武器被运往波士顿，用于加固多切斯特高地，打破波士顿围城的僵局。攻下提康德罗加堡后，一支小分队于5月11日又占领了附近的皇冠角堡。

en.s: The Second Continental Congress (1775–1781) was the meeting of delegates from the Thirteen Colonies that united in support of the American Revolution and Revolutionary War, which established American independence from Great Britain. The Congress constituted a new federation that it first named the United Colonies of North America, and in 1776, renamed the United States of America. The Congress began convening in present-day Independence Hall in Philadelphia, on May 10, 1775, with representatives from 12 of the 13 colonies, following the Battles of Lexington and Concord, the first battles of the Revolutionary War, which were fought on April 19, 1775.

zh.s: 第二届大陆会议（1775—1781年）由十三殖民地派出的代表组成，团结支持美国革命和独立战争，最终促成美国脱离英国独立。会议成立了一个新的联盟，最初称为“北美联合殖民地”，并于1776年改名为“美利坚合众国”。1775年5月10日，列克星敦和康科德战役（独立战争的首场战斗）结束后，来自十三个殖民地中十二个殖民地的代表在今天的费城独立厅开始开会。

en.t: American Revolutionary War: A small Colonial militia led by Ethan Allen and Colonel Benedict Arnold captures Fort Ticonderoga
en.s: The American Revolutionary War (April 19, 1775 – September 3, 1783), also known as the Revolutionary War or American War of Independence or simply the American Revolution, was the armed conflict that comprised the final eight years of the broader American Revolution, in which American Patriot forces organized as the Continental Army and, commanded by George Washington, defeated the British Army.

zh.t: 美国独立战争：伊桑·艾伦和本尼迪克特·阿诺德上校率领一支殖民地民兵小队攻占提康德罗加堡
zh.s: 美国独立战争（1775 年 4 月 19 日—1783 年 9 月 3 日），也称革命战争、美国独立战争或美国革命，是美国革命后八年间的一场武装冲突。美国爱国者部队组成大陆军，在乔治·华盛顿指挥下击败了英国军队。

en.s: The siege of Pensacola, fought from March 9 to May 10, 1781, was the culmination of Spain's conquest of West Florida during the Gulf Coast Campaign of the American Revolutionary War. The siege was commanded by Bernardo de Gálvez, whose nearly 8,000 troops ultimately overran the British forces in the region. The success of the siege resulted in Gálvez' promotion to governor of West Florida and Louisiana.

zh.s: 彭萨科拉围城战于1781年3月9日至5月10日进行，是西班牙在美国独立战争墨西哥湾沿岸战役期间征服西佛罗里达的关键一战。贝尔纳多·德·加尔维斯指挥近8,000名士兵，最终击溃当地英军。围城战获胜后，加尔维斯升任西佛罗里达和路易斯安那总督。

en.s: The 1785 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on May 10, 1785, in order to elect the Governor of South Carolina. Incumbent Lieutenant Governor of South Carolina William Moultrie was elected by the South Carolina General Assembly as he ran unopposed. The exact number of votes cast in this election is unknown.

zh.s: 南卡罗来纳州于1785年5月10日举行州长选举。选举由南卡罗来纳州议会负责，现任副州长威廉·穆尔特里因没有对手而当选。确切投票数不详。

en.s: The 1787 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on May 10, 1787, in order to elect the Governor of South Carolina. Candidate Thomas Pinckney was elected by the South Carolina General Assembly as he ran unopposed. The exact number of votes cast in this election is unknown.

zh.s: 南卡罗来纳州于1787年5月10日举行州长选举。选举由南卡罗来纳州议会负责，托马斯·平克尼因没有对手而当选。确切投票数不详。

en.s: The Battle of Willems (10 May 1794) saw a Republican French army under Jean-Charles Pichegru oppose Coalition forces commanded by Prince Frederick, Duke of York and Albany, as part of a French attempt to defeat an Allied counteroffensive and continue its own 1794 offensive in the Low Countries, which had already seen success with the battle of Mouscron and the capture of the important cities of Menin and Courtrai.

zh.s: 威廉姆斯战役发生于1794年5月10日。让-夏尔·皮舍格鲁率领的法兰西共和国军队与弗雷德里克亲王（约克和奥尔巴尼公爵）指挥的联军交战。法军此举是为了击败盟军反攻，并继续推进1794年在低地国家的攻势；此前法军已在穆斯克龙战役中取胜，并攻占重要城市梅嫩和科特赖克。

en.s: The Battle of Lodi was fought on 10 May 1796 between French forces under General Napoleon Bonaparte and an Austrian rear guard led by Karl Philipp Sebottendorf at Lodi, Lombardy. The rear guard was defeated, but the main body of Johann Peter Beaulieu's Austrian Army had time to retreat.

zh.s: 洛迪战役于1796年5月10日在洛迪（伦巴第）爆发，交战双方是拿破仑·波拿巴将军率领的法军和卡尔·菲利普·塞博滕多夫率领的奥地利后卫部队。奥军后卫被击败，但约翰·彼得·博略率领的奥军主力得以撤退。

en.s: The First Barbary War (1801–1805), also known as the Tripolitan War and the Barbary Coast War, was a conflict during the 1801–1815 Barbary Wars, in which the United States fought against Ottoman Tripolitania. Tripolitania had declared war against the United States over disputes regarding tributary payments in exchange for a cessation of Tripolitanian commerce raiding at sea. United States president Thomas Jefferson refused to pay this tribute.

zh.s: 第一次巴巴里战争（1801—1805年）又称的黎波里战争或巴巴里海岸战争，是1801—1815年巴巴里战争的一部分。当时美国与奥斯曼帝国属地的的黎波里塔尼亚交战。双方因贡金支付问题发生争端；的黎波里塔尼亚要求美国支付贡金，以换取停止在海上袭扰其商船，而美国总统托马斯·杰斐逊拒绝支付。

en.s: In the Blockade of Almeida (14 April – 10 May 1811) a French garrison under Antoine François Brenier de Montmorand was surrounded by approximately 13,000 Anglo-Allied soldiers led by Generals Sir Alexander Campbell, 1st Baronet and Sir William Erskine, 2nd Baronet. After a French relief attempt failed, Brenier and his troops broke out at night after blowing up portions of the fortress.

zh.s: 阿尔梅达围城战于1811年4月14日至5月10日进行。安托万-弗朗索瓦·布雷尼耶·德·蒙莫朗率领的法军驻军被约13,000名英葡联军包围，联军由亚历山大·坎贝尔爵士和威廉·厄斯金爵士指挥。法军援军解围失败后，布雷尼耶和他的部队于夜间突围，并炸毁了部分要塞。

en.t: The National Gallery in London opens to the public
en.s: The National Gallery is an art museum in Trafalgar Square in the City of Westminster, in Central London, England. Founded in 1824, it houses a collection of more than 2,300 paintings dating from the mid-13th century to 1900. The current director of the National Gallery is Gabriele Finaldi. The National Gallery is an exempt charity, and a non-departmental public body of the Department for Culture, Media and Sport.

zh.t: 伦敦国家美术馆向公众开放
zh.s: 国家美术馆位于英格兰伦敦市中心威斯敏斯特市的特拉法加广场，是一座艺术博物馆。美术馆成立于1824年，收藏了2300多幅绘画作品，年代从13世纪中叶至1900年。现任馆长为加布里埃莱·菲纳尔迪。国家美术馆属于豁免慈善机构，也是文化、媒体与体育部下属的非部级公共机构。

en.t: A revolt broke out in southern Vietnam against Emperor Minh Mang, who had desecrated the deceased mandarin Le Van Duyet
en.s: Minh Mạng (Hanoi: [mïŋ˧ maːŋ˧˨ʔ]), also known as Minh Mệnh (Hanoi: [mïŋ˧ məjŋ̟˧˨ʔ], chữ Hán: 明 命, lit. 'the bright favour of Heaven'; 25 May 1791 – 20 January 1841; born Nguyễn Phúc Đảm, also known as Nguyễn Phúc Kiểu), was the second emperor of the Nguyễn dynasty of Vietnam, reigning from 14 February 1820 until his death, on 20 January 1841.

zh.t: 越南南部爆发反对明命帝的叛乱，起因是他亵渎已故官员黎文悦
zh.s: 明命帝（又称明命，越南语河内音：[mïŋ˧ maːŋ˧˨ʔ]；1791 年 5 月 25 日—1841 年 1 月 20 日），本名阮福 đảm，又称阮福皎，是阮朝第二位皇帝，1820 年 2 月 14 日即位，1841 年 1 月 20 日去世。他是嘉隆帝第四子，长兄阮福景于 1801 年去世。他反对法国介入越南，完成越南对占城的最终征服，并曾短暂吞并柬埔寨，同时严格奉行儒家正统。

en.s: The Battle of Nam Quan was fought in 1853 as part of a British anti-piracy operation in China. A Royal Navy sloop-of-war encountered eight pirate ships near Nam Quan and defeated them in a decisive action with help from armed Chinese civilians on land.

zh.s: 1853年，英国在中国开展反海盗行动期间爆发南关之战。一艘英国皇家海军单桅战船在南关附近遭遇八艘海盗船，在岸上持械中国民众的协助下将其击败。

en.s: The Indian Rebellion of 1857 was a rebellion in India against the rule of the British East India Company, that ran from May 1857 to July 1859. The rebellion began as a mutiny of sepoys of the East India Company's army on 10 May 1857, in the cantonment of the town of Meerut, and soon escalated into other mutinies and civilian rebellions largely in the upper Gangetic plain and central India, with the major hostilities confined to present-day Uttar Pradesh, western Bihar, northern Madhya Pradesh, and the Delhi region.

zh.s: 1857年5月至1859年7月，印度爆发反抗英国东印度公司的起义。1857年5月10日，东印度公司军队中的印度兵在密拉特镇驻军营地发动兵变，起义随后扩展为其他兵变和民众反抗，主要发生在恒河上游平原和印度中部。主要战事集中于今北方邦、比哈尔邦西部、中央邦北部和德里地区。

en.s: The Battle of Shamli or Battle of Thana Bhawan was fought on 10 May 1857 between the forces of Imdadullah Muhajir Makki and the East India Company. It was part of the Indian Rebellion of 1857. On 10 May 1857, local Muslims under the leadership of Haji Imdadullah Muhajir Makki gathered at Thana Bhawan, a small town in the Shamli district in current-day Uttar Pradesh, around 120 km from Delhi, to stage a violent protest against Company rule in India.

zh.s: 沙姆利战役又称塔纳巴万战役，于1857年5月10日爆发，交战双方是伊姆达杜拉·穆哈吉尔·麦基率领的部队和东印度公司。战役属于1857年印度起义的一部分。当天，哈吉·伊姆达杜拉·穆哈吉尔·麦基率领当地穆斯林聚集在塔纳巴万镇，准备以暴力抗议东印度公司在印度的统治。该镇位于今天北方邦的沙姆利县，距德里约120公里。

en.s: The naval battle at Fort Pillow, Tennessee (sometimes known as the engagement at Plum Point Bend) took place on the Mississippi River between ships of the Confederate River Defense Fleet, which consisted of a number of wooden sidewheel paddleboats converted to naval rams, and ships of the Union Mississippi River Squadron, which consisted of a number of ironclads, approximately four miles above Fort Pillow, Tennessee on May 10, 1862, during the American Civil War.

zh.s: 1862年5月10日，美国内战期间，邦联河防舰队和联邦密西西比河分舰队在田纳西州普洛姆角湾附近交战。战斗发生在密西西比河上，距皮洛堡上游约四英里。邦联河防舰队由多艘改装为冲角舰的木制明轮船组成，联邦舰队则有多艘铁甲舰。这场海战有时也称皮洛堡战斗。

en.s: The Battle of Cove Mountain was a minor skirmish of the American Civil War, fought on May 10, 1864, in the southwest corner of Virginia near Cove Mountain in Wythe County. On that day, Union Brig. Gen. William W. Averell's cavalry brigade encountered a Confederate brigade under the command of Brig. Gen. William E. "Grumble" Jones. Averell attacked the Confederate positions but was repulsed. The Confederates received reinforcements from Brig. Gen. John Hunt Morgan and counterattacked, chasing the Union forces through the cove area of Wythe County, Virginia. The Confederates held the battlefield as the sun went down.

zh.s: 科夫山战役是美国内战期间的一场小规模冲突，于1864年5月10日在弗吉尼亚州西南部怀斯县科夫山附近发生。当天，威廉·W·阿韦雷尔准将率领的联邦骑兵旅遭遇了威廉·E·“咆哮”·琼斯准将指挥的邦联旅。阿韦雷尔进攻邦联阵地，但被击退。约翰·亨特·摩根准将率援军赶到后，邦联军发起反击，追赶联邦军穿过怀斯县的山谷地区。日落时，邦联军仍控制着战场。

en.s: The Battle of Chester Station was fought on May 10, 1864, between Union and Confederate forces during the American Civil War. The Confederates attacked portions of Benjamin Butler's Union forces.

zh.s: 1864年5月10日，美国内战期间，联邦军和邦联军在弗吉尼亚州交战，史称切斯特站战役。邦联军袭击了本杰明·巴特勒率领的部分联邦军。

en.s: The Naval Battle of Hakodate (函館湾海戦, Hakodatewan Kaisen) was fought from 4 to 10 May 1869, between the remnants of the Tokugawa shogunate navy, consolidated into the armed forces of the rebel Ezo Republic, and the newly formed Imperial Japanese Navy. It was one of the last stages of the Battle of Hakodate during the Boshin War, and occurred near Hakodate in the northern Japanese island of Hokkaido.

zh.s: 函馆湾海战（日语：函馆湾海戦，Hakodatewan Kaisen）于1869年5月4日至10日进行。交战双方是德川幕府海军残部（并入虾夷共和国武装部队）和新成立的大日本帝国海军。这是戊辰战争中函馆之战的最后阶段之一，战斗发生在日本北部北海道函馆附近。

en.t: The First transcontinental railroad, linking the eastern and western United States, is completed at Promontory Summit, Utah Territory with the golden spike
en.s: America's first transcontinental railroad (known originally as the "Pacific Railroad" and later as the "Overland Route") was a 1,911-mile (3,075 km) continuous railroad line built between 1863 and 1869 that connected the existing eastern U.S. rail network at Council Bluffs, Iowa, with the Pacific coast at the Oakland Long Wharf on San Francisco Bay. The rail line was built by three private companies over public lands provided by extensive U.S. land grants.

zh.t: 连接美国东西部的首条横贯大陆铁路在犹他领地普罗蒙特里峰会合，并钉下金钉，工程竣工
zh.s: 美国首条横贯大陆铁路最初称“太平洋铁路”，后来称“陆上线路”，全长1,911英里（3,075公里），建于1863年至1869年，连接爱荷华州康瑟尔布拉夫斯的美国东部铁路网和旧金山湾奥克兰长码头。铁路由三家私营公司在美国政府提供的大量土地上修建。

en.s: The Treaty of Frankfurt (French: Traité de Francfort; German: Friede von Frankfurt) was a peace treaty signed in Frankfurt on 10 May 1871 by the German Empire and the French Third Republic, at the end of the Franco-Prussian War.
en.n: The Treaty of Frankfurt (French: Traité de Francfort; German: Friede von Frankfurt) was a peace treaty signed in Frankfurt on 10 May 1871 by the German Empire and the French Third Republic, at the end of the Franco-Prussian War.

zh.s: 法兰克福条约（法语：Traité de Francfort；德语：Friede von Frankfurt）是普法战争结束时，德意志帝国与法兰西第三共和国于1871年5月10日在法兰克福签署的和平条约。
zh.n: 《法兰克福条约》（法语：Traité de Francfort；德语：Friede von Frankfurt）是普法战争结束时，德意志帝国与法兰西第三共和国于1871年5月10日在法兰克福签署的和平条约。

en.t: Victoria Woodhull becomes the first woman nominated for President of the United States
en.s: Victoria Claflin Woodhull (born Victoria California Claflin; September 23, 1838 – June 9, 1927), later Victoria Woodhull Martin, was an American leader of the women's suffrage movement who ran for president of the United States in the 1872 election. While many historians and authors agree that Woodhull was the first woman to run for the presidency, some disagree with classifying it as a true candidacy because according to the Constitution she would have been too young to be president if elected.

zh.t: 维多利亚·伍德哈尔成为首位获美国总统候选人提名的女性
zh.s: 维多利亚·克拉芙林·伍德哈尔（出生名维多利亚·加利福尼亚·克拉芙林；1838年9月23日—1927年6月9日），后称维多利亚·伍德哈尔·马丁，是美国妇女参政权运动的领袖，曾参加1872年美国总统选举。许多历史学家和作者认为她是首位参选总统的女性，也有人不把她视为正式候选人，因为按照美国宪法，她当选时尚未达到担任总统的年龄。

en.s: The Battle of Dry Lake, also known as Sorass Lake, was the first decisive victory of the United States over the Modoc Indians in northern California in 1873. The battle led to the splintering of the Modoc bands, and was the last major battle of the Modoc War.

zh.s: 干湖之战也称索拉斯湖之战，是1873年美国在加利福尼亚州北部对莫多克人取得的首场决定性胜利。这场战役导致莫多克人分裂，也是莫多克战争中的最后一场重大战役。

en.t: Eleven years later, on 10 May 1877, Romania proclaimed its independence—achieved on the battlefield—and in 1881, on the same day of the year, Carol was crowned as King of Romania
en.s: Romania is a country in Central and Southeastern Europe. It lies on the lower course of the Danube, north of the Balkan Peninsula, and on the northwestern shore of the Black Sea. It borders Ukraine to the north and east, Hungary to the west, Serbia to the southwest, Bulgaria to the south, Moldova to the east, and the Black Sea to the southeast.

zh.t: 罗马尼亚于 1877 年 5 月 10 日宣布独立，十一年后同日加冕的卡罗尔成为罗马尼亚国王
zh.s: 罗马尼亚位于中欧和东南欧，地处多瑙河下游、巴尔干半岛以北和黑海西北岸。其北部和东部与乌克兰接壤，西邻匈牙利，西南邻塞尔维亚，南邻保加利亚，东邻摩尔多瓦，东南濒临黑海。

en.t: Carol I is crowned the King of the Romanian Kingdom
en.s: Carol I or Charles I of Romania (Romanian: Carol I; Romanian: [ˈkarol ɨnˈtɨj] , born Karl Eitel Friedrich Zephyrinus Ludwig von Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen; 20 April 1839 – 10 October [O.S. 27 September] 1914), nicknamed the King of Independence (Romanian: Regele Independenței; Romanian: [ˈre.d͡ʒe.le in.de.penˈden.t͡sej] ); was the monarch of Romania from 1866 to his death in 1914, ruling as Prince (Domnitor) from 1866 to 1881, and as King from 1881 to 1914.

zh.t: 卡罗尔一世加冕为罗马尼亚国王
zh.s: 卡罗尔一世（又称罗马尼亚的查理一世，罗马尼亚语名：Carol I；出生名卡尔·艾特尔·弗里德里希·泽菲里努斯·路德维希·冯·霍亨索伦-锡格马林根；1839年4月20日—1914年10月10日），绰号“独立之王”，自1866年起担任罗马尼亚君主，先以亲王身份执政，1881年至1914年担任国王。

en.s: The Battle of Zand River, also known as the Battle of Sand River was an engagement between the British forces under Lord Roberts that faced a Boer defensive position, led by Louis Botha. The Boers had set up defensive positions at the river, extending around 20 miles, in order to prevent the British from advancing on Kroonstad and Pretoria.

zh.s: 赞德河之战也称桑德河之战，是英国军队与布尔人防守部队之间的一场战斗。英国军队由罗伯茨勋爵率领，布尔军由路易斯·博塔指挥。布尔人在河边修筑了绵延约20英里的防线，试图阻止英军向克龙斯塔德和比勒陀利亚推进。

en.s: The Bury by-election, 1902 was a by-election held in England on 10 May 1902 for the House of Commons constituency of Bury in Lancashire. It was the first by-election gain by the Liberal Party from the ruling Conservatives in the Parliament of 1900–1906 and it can arguably be said to have set in motion the swing to the Liberals from the Tories which brought twenty by-election gains in all over the following months, leading to the Liberals landslide victory in the 1906 general election.

zh.s: 1902年5月10日，英格兰兰开夏郡伯里下议院选区举行补选。这是1900至1906年议会期间自由党首次从执政的保守党手中赢得补选席位。此后数月，自由党又赢得20场补选，党势转强，最终在1906年大选中取得压倒性胜利。

All 403 seats in the Congress of Deputies were up for election, as well as 180 of 360 seats in the Senate.

en.t: The Horch & Cir. Motorwagenwerke AG is founded. It would eventually become the Audi company
en.s: Horch (German pronunciation: [hɔʁç] ) was a German car manufacturer, which traced its roots to several companies founded in the late 19th and early 20th century by August Horch. It is one of the predecessors of the present day Audi company, which itself resulted from the merger of Auto Union Aktiengesellschaft (AG) and NSU Motorenwerke in 1969.

zh.t: 霍希汽车制造公司成立，后来成为奥迪公司的前身
zh.s: 霍希（德语发音：[hɔʁç]）是一家德国汽车制造商，其历史可追溯到奥古斯特·霍希在 19 世纪末至 20 世纪初创办的多家公司。霍希是奥迪公司的前身之一；奥迪公司则由汽车联盟股份公司与 NSU 汽车制造公司于 1969 年合并而成。

en.s: The Battle on the Oreške fields was a battle between Serbian Chetniks from Macedonia and Macedonian Bulgarians in the area of western Vardar that took place on May 10, 1905. The battle resulted in a decisive Chetnik victory and the destruction of the Bulgarian committee company of Stefan Dimitrov.

zh.s: 奥雷什凯田野战役于1905年5月10日在西瓦尔达尔地区爆发，交战双方是来自马其顿地区的塞尔维亚切特尼克部队和马其顿保加利亚人。战斗以切特尼克部队决定性获胜告终，斯特凡·迪米特洛夫的保加利亚委员会连队被歼灭。

en.s: The Stepney by-election of 1907 was held on 10 May 1907. The by-election was held due to the resignation of the incumbent Conservative MP, William Evans-Gordon. It was won by the Conservative candidate Frederick Leverton Harris.

zh.s: 1907年5月10日，斯特普尼选区举行补选。保守党籍现任议员威廉·埃文斯-戈登辞职后触发此次补选。保守党候选人弗雷德里克·莱弗顿·哈里斯获胜。

en.s: The First Battle of Ciudad Juárez took place in April and May 1911 between federal forces loyal to President Porfirio Díaz and rebel forces of Francisco Madero, during the Mexican Revolution. Pascual Orozco and Pancho Villa commanded Madero's army, which besieged Ciudad Juárez, Chihuahua. After two days of fighting the city's garrison surrendered and Orozco and Villa took control of the town.

zh.s: 第一次华雷斯城战役于1911年4月至5月在墨西哥革命期间爆发，交战双方是效忠波菲里奥·迪亚斯总统的联邦军和弗朗西斯科·马德罗领导的反叛军。帕斯夸尔·奥罗斯科和潘乔·比利亚率领马德罗的军队围攻奇瓦瓦州华雷斯城。经过两天战斗，守军投降，奥罗斯科和比利亚控制了该城。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 26 April and 10 May 1914, three months before the outbreak of World War I. The Radical Socialist Party emerged as the largest party, though, with the outbreak of the First World War, many in the Chamber, ranging from Catholics to socialists, united to form the Union sacrée. The elections saw 192 new members elected.

zh.s: 法国于1914年4月26日和5月10日举行立法选举，距第一次世界大战爆发还有三个月。激进社会党成为最大党。不过，第一次世界大战爆发后，从天主教徒到社会主义者，众议院中的许多人团结起来组成“神圣联盟”。本次选举产生了192名新议员。

en.s: The 1914 Copa del Rey final was the 14th final of the Spanish cup competition, the Copa del Rey. The final was played at Costorbe in Irun on 10 May 1914. The match was won by Athletic Bilbao, who beat España FC 2–1. The star of the match was Severino Zuazo, who scored the goals that gave the cup to Athletic, while Jaime Villena reduced the deficit for España (a club from Barcelona, but separate from RCD Espanyol) with two minutes remaining.

zh.s: 1914年西班牙国王杯决赛是西班牙杯赛国王杯的第14届决赛。比赛于1914年5月10日在伊伦的科斯托贝球场举行。毕尔巴鄂竞技以2比1击败埃斯帕尼亚足球俱乐部夺冠。塞韦里诺·苏阿索打入两球，帮助毕尔巴鄂竞技捧杯；比赛还剩两分钟时，海梅·比列纳为埃斯帕尼亚扳回一球。该俱乐部来自巴塞罗那，与皇家西班牙人俱乐部并非同一队。

en.s: The action of 10 May 1915, or Battle of the Bosporus, was a naval encounter between the Russian pre-dreadnought squadron and the Ottoman battlecruiser Yavuz Sultan Selim in the Black Sea, north of the Bosporus. After a brief exchange of fire the Ottomans withdrew. The battle took place during the main operation of the Black Sea Fleet aimed at shelling the Bosporus fortifications.

zh.s: 1915年5月10日海战又称博斯普鲁斯海战，是俄罗斯前无畏舰分舰队与奥斯曼战列巡洋舰“亚武兹苏丹塞利姆”号在黑海博斯普鲁斯海峡以北的一次海上交战。双方短暂交火后，奥斯曼舰队撤退。此战发生在黑海舰队炮击博斯普鲁斯海峡防御工事的主要行动期间。

en.s: The Battle of Dunajetz occurred in the May 1–10, 1915 as part of the Gorlice–Tarnów Offensive during World War I. The German 11th Army led by General August von Mackensen, with the support on the flanks by the Austro-Hungarian 3rd and 4th Armies, defeated the Russian 3rd Army. For the first time in the history of the First World War a heavily fortified and long-term defensive position was broken through during the Gorliсе offensive.

zh.s: 杜纳耶茨河战役于1915年5月1日至10日进行，是第一次世界大战期间戈尔利采—塔尔努夫攻势的一部分。奥古斯特·冯·马肯森将军率领的德国第11集团军，在奥匈帝国第3和第4集团军两翼支援下，击败俄罗斯第3集团军。戈尔利采攻势期间，德奥联军首次突破第一次世界大战中防守严密、长期坚守的阵地。

en.s: On 10 May 1917, the association football teams of the Philippines and Japan faced each other at the 1917 Far Eastern Games. The tournament was contested by Japan, the Philippines and China. The Japanese team was represented by a selection from the Tokyo Higher Normal School. Paulino Alcántara, a renowned football player, was part of the Philippine squad who led the Philippines to its biggest recorded victory in an international football match which also became Japan's biggest defeat.

zh.s: 1917年5月10日，菲律宾和日本足球队在1917年远东运动会上交锋。本届赛事由日本、菲律宾和中国参赛。日本队由东京高等师范学校选拔球员组成。著名球员保利诺·阿尔坎塔拉代表菲律宾队出战，帮助球队创下有记录以来国际足球赛的最大比分胜利，同时也使日本队遭遇队史最大失利。

en.s: General elections were held in Japan on 10 May 1920. The result was a victory for the Rikken Seiyūkai party led by Hara Takashi, which won 278 of the 464 seats.

zh.s: 1920年5月10日，日本举行大选。原敬领导的立宪政友会获胜，赢得464个席位中的278席。

en.t: The United States annexes the Kingman Reef
en.s: Kingman Reef () is a largely submerged, uninhabited, triangle-shaped reef, geologically an atoll, 9.0 nmi (20 km) east-west and 4.5 nmi (8 km) north-south, in the North Pacific Ocean, roughly halfway between the Hawaiian Islands and American Samoa. It has an area of 3 hectares (0.03 km2; 7.4 acres) and is an unincorporated territory of the United States in Oceania.

zh.s: 金曼礁是一座大部分没入水下、无人居住的三角形礁体，从地质上看属于环礁。它东西长 9.0 海里（20 公里），南北宽 4.5 海里（8 公里），位于北太平洋，约在夏威夷群岛与美属萨摩亚之间。礁体面积为 3 公顷（0.03 平方公里；7.4 英亩），是美国在大洋洲的无建制领地。

en.s: The 1922 Football Association Charity Shield was played on 10 May 1922. The game was played at Old Trafford, home of Manchester United, and was contested by the FA Cup holders Huddersfield Town and First Division champions Liverpool. The game ended in a 1–0 win for Huddersfield Town with the winning goal scored by Tom Wilson. This was the last Charity Shield game to take place in May.

zh.s: 1922年英格兰足总慈善盾比赛于1922年5月10日举行，在曼彻斯特联主场老特拉福德球场进行。对阵双方是足总杯冠军哈德斯菲尔德镇和英格兰甲级联赛冠军利物浦。哈德斯菲尔德镇以1比0获胜，汤姆·威尔逊打入制胜球。这是慈善盾最后一次在5月举行。

en.t: J. Edgar Hoover is appointed first Director of the United States' Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), and remains so until his death in 1972
en.s: John Edgar Hoover (January 1, 1895 – May 2, 1972) was an American law enforcement administrator who served as the fifth and final director of the Bureau of Investigation (BOI) and the first director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). President Calvin Coolidge first appointed Hoover as director of the BOI, the predecessor to the FBI, in 1924.

zh.t: J. 埃德加·胡佛获任联邦调查局首任局长
zh.s: 约翰·埃德加·胡佛（1895年1月1日—1972年5月2日）是美国执法机构负责人，曾任调查局第五任也是最后一任局长，以及联邦调查局首任局长。卡尔文·柯立芝总统于1924年首次任命胡佛为调查局局长；该机构是联邦调查局的前身。

en.s: The 1925 Copa del Rey final was the 25th final of the Spanish cup competition, the Copa del Rey. The final was played at Reina Victoria, in Seville, on May 10, 1925. Barcelona beat Arenas 2–0 to win their sixth title.

zh.s: 1925年西班牙国王杯决赛是西班牙杯赛国王杯的第25届决赛。比赛于1925年5月10日在塞维利亚的维多利亚女王球场举行。巴塞罗那以2比0击败阿雷纳斯，赢得队史第六座冠军。

en.t: May 1932 Hong Kong sanitary board election
en.s: The May 1932 Hong Kong Sanitary Board election was held on 10 May 1932 for one of the two unofficial seats in the Sanitary Board of Hong Kong. It was one of the few contests in the Sanitary Board elections. Only ratepayers who were included in the Special and Common Jury Lists of the years or ratepayers who are exempted from serving on Juries on account of their professional avocations, unofficial members of the Executive or Legislative Council, or categories of profession were entitled to vote at the election.

zh.s: 1932年5月香港洁净局选举于5月10日举行，改选洁净局两个非官守议席中的一个。这是洁净局选举中少数有竞争的选举之一。只有列入当年特别陪审团和普通陪审团名单的纳税人、因职业原因获豁免陪审义务的纳税人、行政局或立法局非官守议员，以及若干职业类别的人士，才有资格投票。

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Spain on 26 April and 10 May 1936. In the first stage, 473 electors were elected; in the second, the 473 electors convened in an Electoral College with the 473 members of the Congress of Deputies in order to elect the President of the Spanish Republic, as required by Article 68 of the Spanish Constitution of 1931.

zh.s: 西班牙于1936年4月26日和5月10日举行间接总统选举。第一阶段选出了473名选举人；第二阶段，这473名选举人与众议院的473名议员组成选举团，依照1931年《西班牙宪法》第68条选举西班牙共和国总统。

en.s: The invasion of Iceland, codenamed Operation Fork, was a British military operation conducted by the Royal Navy and Royal Marines during World War II to occupy and deny Iceland to Germany. At the start of the war, Britain imposed strict export controls on Icelandic goods, preventing profitable shipments to Germany, as part of its naval blockade. Britain offered assistance to Iceland, seeking cooperation "as a belligerent and an ally", but Reykjavik declined and reaffirmed its neutrality. The German diplomatic presence in Iceland, along with the island's strategic importance, alarmed the British.

zh.s: 代号“叉子行动”的冰岛入侵行动，是第二次世界大战期间英国皇家海军和皇家海军陆战队执行的一次军事行动，目的是占领冰岛，防止德国控制该岛。战争初期，英国对冰岛商品实施严格的出口管制，阻止冰岛向德国进行有利可图的运输，这是英国海上封锁的一部分。英国提出援助冰岛，并希望双方以交战国和盟友的身份合作，但雷克雅未克方面拒绝了提议，并重申中立立场。英国还担心德国在冰岛的外交存在以及该岛的战略重要性。

en.s: The German invasion of Luxembourg was part of Case Yellow (German: Fall Gelb), the German invasion of the Low Countries (Belgium, Luxembourg and the Netherlands) and France during World War II. The battle began on 10 May 1940 and lasted just one day. Facing only light resistance, Luxembourg was quickly occupied. The Luxembourgish government, and Grand Duchess Charlotte, managed to escape the country and a government-in-exile was created in London.

zh.s: 德国入侵卢森堡是“黄色方案”（德语：Fall Gelb）的一部分。这项作战计划旨在入侵低地国家（比利时、卢森堡和荷兰）及法国。战斗于1940年5月10日开始，仅持续一天。卢森堡只进行了轻微抵抗，很快便被占领。卢森堡政府和大公夏洛特成功逃离该国，流亡政府随后在伦敦成立。

en.s: The Battle for The Hague (Dutch: Slag om Den Haag) took place on 10 May 1940 during the Battle of the Netherlands. German Fallschirmjäger units were dropped in and around The Hague to capture Dutch airfields and the city itself. After securing a bridgehead, Nazi Germany had expected the Netherlands to surrender that day. The Germans, however, failed to achieve that objective since their forces had been unable to hold onto their initial gains.

zh.s: 海牙战役（荷兰语：Slag om Den Haag）于1940年5月10日在荷兰战役期间爆发。德国空降猎兵部队空降到海牙及周边地区，试图夺取荷兰机场和海牙市区。德国在建立桥头堡后，原以为荷兰会在当天投降；但德军未能守住最初占领的地区，因此没有达到这一目标。

en.s: The Battle of Maastricht was one of the first battles that took place during the German Campaign on the Western Front during World War II. Maastricht was a key city in order to capture the Belgian Fort Eben-Emael and split the allied armies in half. The German goal of the operation was to take the main bridges over the river Maas intact, to have an easier road to central Belgium.

zh.s: 马斯特里赫特战役是第二次世界大战西线德军战役初期的战斗之一。马斯特里赫特是攻占比利时埃本-埃美尔要塞、分割盟军的重要地点。德军计划完整夺取马斯河上的主要桥梁，以便更顺利地推进到比利时中部。

en.t: World War II: Winston Churchill is appointed Prime Minister of the United Kingdom following the resignation of Neville Chamberlain. On the same day, Germany invades France, The Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg. Meanwhile, the United Kingdom occupies Iceland
en.s: Sir Winston Leonard Spencer Churchill (30 November 1874 – 24 January 1965) was a British statesman, military officer, and writer who was Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1940 to 1945, during the Second World War, and again from 1951 to 1955. For some 62 of the years between 1900 and 1964, he was a member of Parliament (MP) and represented a total of five constituencies over that time.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战：温斯顿·丘吉尔获任英国首相，接替辞职的内维尔·张伯伦；同日德国入侵法国、荷兰、比利时和卢森堡，英国则占领冰岛
zh.s: 温斯顿·伦纳德·斯宾塞·丘吉尔爵士（1874 年 11 月 30 日—1965 年 1 月 24 日）是英国政治家、军官和作家，曾于 1940 至 1945 年以及 1951 至 1955 年担任英国首相。1900 至 1964 年间，他有约 62 年担任议员，先后代表五个选区。

en.t: World War II: German fighters accidentally bomb the German city of Freiburg
en.s: World War II, or the Second World War (1 September 1939 – 2 September 1945), was a global conflict between two coalitions: the Allies and the Axis powers. Nearly all of the world's countries participated, with many engaging in total war on an unprecedented scale. World War II was the deadliest conflict in history, causing the deaths of 60 to 75 million people, a majority of whom were civilians.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战：德国战斗机误炸德国城市弗赖堡
zh.s: 第二次世界大战（又称二战）是两个联盟之间的全球性冲突，几乎所有国家都参与其中，许多国家投入了前所未有的全面战争。这是历史上伤亡最惨重的冲突，造成约 6000 万至 7500 万人死亡，其中大多数是平民。

en.s: The 1941 New South Wales state election was held on 10 May 1941. This election was for all of the 90 seats in the 33rd New South Wales Legislative Assembly and was conducted in single-member constituencies with compulsory preferential voting.

zh.s: 新南威尔士州于1941年5月10日举行州选举，改选第三届立法议会全部90个席位。选举采用单一席位选区，并实行强制偏好投票。

en.t: World War II: Rudolf Hess parachutes into Scotland to try to negotiate a peace deal between the United Kingdom and Nazi Germany
en.s: Rudolf Walter Richard Hess (Heß in German; 26 April 1894 – 17 August 1987) was a German politician, convicted war criminal, and a leading member of the Nazi Party in Germany. Appointed Deputy to the Führer (Stellvertreter des Führers) in 1933, Hess held that position until 1941, when he flew solo to Scotland in an attempt to negotiate the United Kingdom's exit from the Second World War.

zh.t: 鲁道夫·赫斯跳伞抵达苏格兰，试图促成英国与纳粹德国和谈
zh.s: 鲁道夫·瓦尔特·理查德·赫斯（德语名：Heß；1894年4月26日—1987年8月17日）是德国政治人物、被定罪的战犯，也是纳粹党的重要成员。1933年起，他担任纳粹党副元首，直至1941年独自飞往苏格兰，试图促使英国退出第二次世界大战。

en.s: OB 318 was a North Atlantic convoy which ran during the Battle of the Atlantic in World War II. During Operation Primrose Royal Navy convoy escorts HMS Bulldog, Broadway and Aubrietia captured U-110 with an intact Enigma machine and a wealth of signals intelligence, which led to the Allied breakthrough into cracking the German naval Enigma code.

zh.s: 1948年法国杯决赛于1948年5月10日在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦尔奥林匹克体育场举行。里尔奥林匹克体育俱乐部以3比2击败朗斯竞技俱乐部，罗歇·范多伦和让·巴拉特（梅开二度）为里尔进球。

en.t: Temporary Provisions against the Communist Rebellion

en.s: The 1957 Colombian coup d'état was the nonviolent overthrow in Colombia of the Gustavo Rojas Pinilla dictatorship by the military, resulting in the establishment of a five-man junta that restored civilian rule a year later in 1958. The coup attempt followed a period of civil unrest as Rojas, coming to power in 1953 promising to end the La Violencia and initially hailed as Colombia's savior, caused political discontent with his authoritarian policies, including silencing of the free press, detainment of opposition groups, and suspension of the country's constitution.

zh.s: 1957年哥伦比亚政变以非暴力方式推翻了古斯塔沃·罗哈斯·皮尼利亚的独裁统治。政变后成立五人执政委员会，并于1958年恢复文官政府。此前，罗哈斯于1953年上台，承诺结束“暴力时期”，起初被视为哥伦比亚的救星；但他压制新闻自由、拘押反对派团体并中止宪法，引发了政治不满和社会动荡。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Austria on 10 May 1959.Although the Social Democratic Party received the most votes, the Austrian People's Party retained a bare one-seat plurality. The Communist Party of Austria lost its remaining three seats and has not returned to the National Council since. Voter turnout was 94.2%. The grand coalition that had governed the country since 1945 remained in office, with People's Party leader Julius Raab as Chancellor and Socialist leader Bruno Pittermann as Vice-Chancellor.

en.s: The 21st Cannes Film Festival was to have been held on May 10 – 24, 1968, before being curtailled due to the turmoil of May 1968 in France. en.s: The first Sarawak state election was held from Saturday, 10 May 1969 and scheduled to be completed on Saturday, 7 June 1969 which lasted for 4 weeks and was carried out in staggered basis. en.s: A general election was held on Saturday, 10 May 1969 for members of the 3rd Parliament of Malaysia, although voting was postponed until between 6 June and 4 July 1970 in Sabah and Sarawak. The incumbent Labor Party, which had been in power continuously since 1934, was led by Eric Reece, who had been premier of Tasmania since 1958.

en.s: Elections to Sheffield Council were held on 10 May 1973. The Local Government Act 1972 stipulated that the elected members were to shadow and eventually take over from the predecessor corporation on 1 April 1974. The order in which the councillors were elected dictated their term serving, with third-place candidates serving two years and up for re-election in 1975, second-placed three years expiring in 1976 and 1st-placed five years until 1978.

This election would create the entire 60-member council, which would shadow its predecessor councils before taking over their functions on 1 April 1974, as specified in the Local Government Act 1972.

zh.t: 1973年斯托克波特都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 斯托克波特议会首次选举于1973年5月10日（星期四）举行。新议会取代斯托克波特郡自治市、布雷德伯里和罗米利城区、奇德尔和盖特利城区、黑泽尔格罗夫和布拉姆霍尔城区，以及马普尔城区。此次选举选出了全部60名议员。根据1972年《地方政府法》，新议会先组成过渡议会，之后于1974年4月1日接管原有议会的职能。

en.s: The 1973 Sunderland Metropolitan Borough Council election was held on 10 May 1973 as part of the first elections to the new local authorities established by the Local Government Act 1972 in England and Wales. The entirety of the new 78-seat council was up for election, with each of the 26 new council wards returning three councillors by first-past-the-post.

zh.t: 1973年桑德兰都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1973年桑德兰都会自治市议会选举于5月10日举行，是英格兰和威尔士依据1972年《地方政府法》为新设地方政府举行的首轮选举之一。新议会全部78个席位均须改选，26个新选区各采用简单多数制选出三名议员。

en.s: The 1973 West Norfolk District Council election took place on 10 May 1973 to elect members of West Norfolk District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. This was the inaugural election to West Norfolk District Council, with the council having been recently established by the Local Government Act 1972.

zh.s: 西诺福克区议会选举于1973年5月10日举行，为英格兰诺福克郡西诺福克区议会选出议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。这是依据1972年《地方政府法》成立西诺福克区议会后的首次选举。

en.s: The 1973 South Norfolk District Council election took place on 10 May 1973 to elect members of South Norfolk District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. This was the inaugural election of the council following its formation by the Local Government Act 1972.

zh.s: 南诺福克区议会选举于1973年5月10日举行，为英格兰诺福克郡南诺福克区议会选出议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。这是依据1972年《地方政府法》成立该议会后的首次选举。

en.s: The first elections to the newly created Barnsley Metropolitan Borough Council were held on 10 May 1973, with the entirety of the 60 seat council - three seats for each of the 20 wards - up for vote. The Local Government Act 1972 stipulated that the elected members were to shadow and eventually take over from the predecessor corporation on 1 April 1974.

zh.t: 1973年巴恩斯利都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 新成立的巴恩斯利都会自治市议会首次选举于1973年5月10日举行，全部60个席位均须改选，20个选区各选出三名议员。根据1972年《地方政府法》，当选议员先组成过渡议会，最终于1974年4月1日接替原有市政机构。

en.s: The 1973 Pastonacres District Council election took place on 10 May 1973 to elect members of Pastonacres District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. This was the inaugural election to the council following its creation by the Local Government Act 1972. Between the 1973 and 1976 elections, the council was renamed to North Norfolk District Council.

zh.t: 1973年帕斯托纳克雷斯区议会选举
zh.s: 帕斯托纳克雷斯区议会选举于1973年5月10日举行，为英格兰诺福克郡帕斯托纳克雷斯区议会选出议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。这是依据1972年《地方政府法》成立该议会后的首次选举。1973年至1976年选举期间，该议会更名为北诺福克区议会。

en.s: Elections to Erewash District Council were held on 10 May 1973 as part of nationwide local elections. The new district was formed by the merger of the Borough of Ilkeston, the Long Eaton urban district and the parishes of Breadsall, Breaston, Dale Abbey, Draycott and Church Wilne, Hopwell, Little Eaton, Morley, Ockbrook, Risley, Sandiacre, Stanley, Stanton by Dale and West Hallam from the South East Derbyshire Rural District.

zh.s: 埃雷沃什区议会选举于1973年5月10日举行，是全英国地方选举的一部分。新设的埃雷沃什区由伊尔克斯顿自治市、朗伊顿城区，以及原东南德比郡乡村区的多个教区合并而成，包括布雷兹索尔、布雷斯顿、戴尔修道院、德雷科特和丘奇威尔讷、霍普韦尔、小伊顿、莫利、奥克布鲁克、里斯利、桑迪阿克、斯坦利、斯坦顿拜戴尔和西霍勒姆。

en.s: The 1973 Rochford District Council election took place on 10 May 1973 to elect members of Rochford District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. This was the inaugural election of the council following its formation by the Local Government Act 1972.

zh.s: 罗奇福德区议会选举于1973年5月10日举行，为英格兰埃塞克斯郡罗奇福德区议会选出议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。这是依据1972年《地方政府法》成立该议会后的首次选举。

en.s: The first elections to Tameside Council were held on Thursday, 10 May 1973. This was a new council created to replace the municipal boroughs of Ashton-under-Lyne, Dukinfield, Hyde, Mossley, and Stalybridge, and the urban districts of Audenshaw, Denton, Droylesden, and Longdendale. This election would create the entire 54-member council, which would shadow its predecessor councils before taking over their functions on 1 April 1974, as specified in the Local Government Act 1972.

zh.t: 1973年泰姆赛德都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 泰姆赛德议会首次选举于1973年5月10日（星期四）举行。新议会取代阿什顿安德莱恩、杜金菲尔德、海德、莫斯利和斯泰利布里奇等市政自治市，以及奥德肖、丹顿、德罗伊尔斯登和朗登代尔等城区。此次选举选出了全部54名议员。根据1972年《地方政府法》，新议会先组成过渡议会，之后于1974年4月1日接管原有议会的职能。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Yugoslavia between 16 March and 10 May 1974 through a complicated delegate system which selected delegates to local, republic, and federal assemblies.

zh.s: 南斯拉夫于1974年3月16日至5月10日举行议会选举，通过复杂的代表选举制度，选出地方、共和国和联邦议会的代表。

en.s: The 1978 European Cup final was an association football match between Club Brugge of Belgium and Liverpool of England on 10 May 1978 at Wembley Stadium, London, England (the venue was decided in Bern by the UEFA Executive Committee on 20 September 1977). It was the final match of the 1977–78 season of Europe's premier cup competition, the European Cup.

zh.s: 1978年欧洲冠军杯决赛于1978年5月10日在英格兰伦敦温布利球场举行，由比利时布鲁日俱乐部对阵英格兰利物浦。比赛场地由欧洲足联执行委员会于1977年9月20日在伯尔尼决定。这是1977—78赛季欧洲顶级俱乐部赛事欧洲冠军杯的最后一场比赛。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Yugoslavia between 10 March and 10 May 1978 through a complicated delegate system which selected delegates to local, republic, and federal assemblies. They were the final federal elections held before the death of Josip Broz Tito.

zh.s: 南斯拉夫于1978年3月10日至5月10日举行议会选举，通过复杂的代表选举制度，选出地方、共和国和联邦议会的代表。这是约瑟普·布罗兹·铁托去世前最后一次联邦选举。

en.s: Operation Reindeer, which began on 4 May 1978, was South Africa's second major military operation in Angola, the first being Operation Savannah. The South African operation consisted of an assault by 2 South African Infantry Battalion on two South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO) base complexes, Chetequera and Dombondola, near to the then-South West Africa/Angola border; an assault by the elite 32 Battalion on SWAPO's Omepepa-Namuidi-Henhombe base complex around 20 km east of Chetequera; and finally, the attack the operation is most known for — a controversial airborne assault by paratroopers on Cassinga, a refugee camp and SWAPO's regional headquarters, 260 km inside Angola.

zh.s: 驯鹿行动于1978年5月4日开始，是南非在安哥拉开展的第二次大型军事行动，第一次是萨凡纳行动。南非军队首先派出第2南非步兵营，袭击西南非洲人民组织（SWAPO）在当时西南非洲与安哥拉边境附近的切特克拉和东邦多隆达两个基地群；接着，精锐的第32营袭击了奥梅佩帕—纳穆伊迪—亨洪贝基地群，该基地群位于切特克拉以东约20公里处。行动最为人熟知的一部分，是伞兵对卡辛加难民营发动的争议性空降突袭。卡辛加位于安哥拉境内260公里处，也是SWAPO地区总部。

en.s: The 1979 British Columbia general election was the 32nd general election in the Province of British Columbia, Canada. It was held to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of British Columbia. The election was called on April 3, 1979. The election was held on May 10, 1979, and the new legislature met for the first time on June 6, 1979.

zh.s: 加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省于1979年5月10日举行第32届省级大选，选出省议会议员。选举于4月3日宣布举行。新一届议会于1979年6月6日首次开会。

en.s: The 32nd Cannes Film Festival took place from 10 to 24 May 1979. French writer Françoise Sagan served as jury president for the main competition. The Palme d'Or, the festival's top prize, was jointly awarded to Apocalypse Now by Francis Ford Coppola (screened as a work in progress), and The Tin Drum by Volker Schlöndorff.

zh.s: 第32届戛纳电影节于1979年5月10日至24日举行。法国作家弗朗索瓦丝·萨冈担任主竞赛单元评审团主席。电影节最高奖金棕榈奖由弗朗西斯·福特·科波拉执导的《现代启示录》（以未完成版放映）和沃尔克·施隆多夫执导的《铁皮鼓》共同获得。

en.s: The 1980 Scottish Cup Final was played on 10 May 1980 at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 95th Scottish Cup competition. Old Firm rivals Celtic and Rangers contested the match, which Celtic won 1–0 after extra time when George McCluskey scored the winning goal off a corner. Rioting after the end of the match, involving both sets of supporters, resulted in the sale of alcohol being banned at sporting events in Scotland.

zh.s: 第95届苏格兰杯决赛于1980年5月10日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园举行。老字号宿敌凯尔特人和流浪者交锋，凯尔特人经过加时赛以1比0获胜，乔治·麦克拉斯基在角球进攻中打入制胜球。赛后双方球迷发生骚乱，苏格兰随后禁止在体育赛事期间销售酒类。

en.s: The 1980 FA Cup final was contested by Arsenal and West Ham United at Wembley. West Ham won by a single goal, scored by Trevor Brooking. To date, it is the last time a team from outside the top flight has won the FA Cup. It was West Ham's third FA Cup triumph and the last time that they had won a major trophy until their UEFA Europa Conference League victory in 2023.

zh.s: 1980年英格兰足总杯决赛由阿森纳对阵西汉姆联，在温布利球场举行。西汉姆联凭借特雷弗·布鲁金打入的一球获胜。截至目前，这是顶级联赛以外的球队最后一次赢得足总杯。这是西汉姆联第三次夺得足总杯；此后直到2023年赢得欧足联欧洲协会联赛之前，他们再未获得重要赛事冠军。

en.s: The French presidential election of 1981 took place on 10 May 1981, giving the presidency of France to François Mitterrand, the first Socialist president of the Fifth Republic. In the first round of voting on 26 April 1981, a political spectrum of ten candidates stood for election, and the leading two candidates – Mitterrand and Valéry Giscard d'Estaing – advanced to a second round. Mitterrand and his Socialist Party received 51.76% of the vote, while Giscard and his Union for French Democracy trailed with about 48.24%, a margin of 1,065,956 votes. The Socialist Party's electoral program was called 110 Propositions for France.

zh.s: 1981年5月10日，法国举行总统选举，弗朗索瓦·密特朗胜出，成为第五共和国首位社会党籍总统。4月26日举行的首轮投票中，10名候选人参选，得票领先的密特朗和瓦莱里·吉斯卡尔·德斯坦进入第二轮。密特朗和社会党获得51.76%的选票，吉斯卡尔和法国民主联盟获得约48.24%，双方相差1,065,956票。社会党的竞选纲领名为《法国110项提议》。

en.s: The 1981 WFA Cup Final was the 11th final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. It was the eleventh final to be held under the direct control of Women's Football Association (WFA). St Helens and Southampton Women's F.C. contested the match at Knowsley Road, the former home stadium of St Helens on 10 May 1981.

zh.s: 1981年女子足总杯决赛是英格兰女子足球主要杯赛的第11届决赛，也是女子足球协会直接管理下举行的第11届决赛。圣海伦斯和南安普敦女子足球俱乐部于1981年5月10日在诺斯利路球场交锋。该球场曾是圣海伦斯的主场。

en.t: The extension was formally opened on 10 May 1982 by Sir Philip Haddon-Cave, the acting governor and former chairman of the Mass Transit Railway Provisional Authority
en.s: The Tsuen Wan line (Chinese: 荃灣綫) is one of the ten lines of the metro network in Hong Kong's MTR. There are 16 stations on the line. The southern terminus is Central station on Hong Kong Island and the northwestern terminus is Tsuen Wan station in the New Territories. A journey on the entire line takes approximately 35 minutes.

zh.t: 荃湾线延线于 1982 年 5 月 10 日由署理港督兼地铁临时管理局前主席夏鼎基爵士主持正式启用
zh.s: 荃湾线是香港地铁网络的十条线路之一，共有 16 个车站。南端终点为香港岛的中环站，西北端终点为新界的荃湾站，全程约需 35 分钟。

en.s: The 1986 Scottish Cup Final was played on 10 May 1986 at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 111th Scottish Cup. The previous winners were Celtic, who had beaten Dundee United in the 1985 final, but they were knocked out by Hibernian at the quarter-final stage.

zh.s: 第111届苏格兰杯决赛于1986年5月10日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园举行。上届冠军凯尔特人曾在1985年决赛中击败邓迪联，但本届比赛中，凯尔特人在四分之一决赛阶段被希伯尼安淘汰。

en.s: The 1986 FA Cup final was the 105th final of the FA Cup. It took place on 10 May 1986 at Wembley Stadium and was a Merseyside derby between Everton and Liverpool. The match was played seven days after Liverpool had secured the league title, with Everton finishing as runners-up. At the time, Everton and Liverpool were widely regarded as the two leading English clubs.

zh.s: 1986年英格兰足总杯决赛是第105届足总杯决赛，于1986年5月10日在温布利球场举行。决赛是默西塞德德比，由埃弗顿对阵利物浦。比赛比利物浦锁定联赛冠军晚七天举行，当时埃弗顿获得联赛亚军。彼时，埃弗顿和利物浦普遍被视为英格兰最强的两支俱乐部。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Yugoslavia between 10 March and 10 May 1986 through a complicated delegate system which selected delegates to local, republic, and federal assemblies. These were the final parliamentary elections to be held in Yugoslavia as the country started to break up five years later.

zh.s: 南斯拉夫于1986年3月10日至5月10日举行议会选举，通过复杂的代表选举制度，选出地方、共和国和联邦议会的代表。这是南斯拉夫解体前最后一次议会选举；该国于五年后开始解体。

en.s: The 1989 European Cup Winners' Cup Final was a football match contested between Barcelona of Spain and Sampdoria of Italy. It was the final match of the 1988–89 European Cup Winners' Cup and the 29th European Cup Winners' Cup final. The final was held at Wankdorf Stadium in Bern, Switzerland, on 10 May 1989. Barcelona won the match 2–0 thanks to goals by Julio Salinas and Luis López Rekarte.

zh.s: 1989年欧洲优胜者杯决赛由西班牙巴塞罗那对阵意大利桑普多利亚，是1988—89赛季欧洲优胜者杯的最后一场比赛，也是第29届欧洲优胜者杯决赛。比赛于1989年5月10日在瑞士伯尔尼的万克多夫球场举行。巴塞罗那凭借胡利奥·萨利纳斯和路易斯·洛佩斯·雷卡特的进球，以2比0获胜。

en.s: The 43rd Cannes Film Festival was held on May 10-21, 1990. The Palme d'Or went to the Wild at Heart by David Lynch. The festival opened with Dreams, directed by Akira Kurosawa and closed with The Comfort of Strangers, directed by Paul Schrader.

zh.s: 第43届戛纳电影节于1990年5月10日至21日举行。大卫·林奇执导的《我心狂野》获得金棕榈奖。电影节以黑泽明执导的《梦》开幕，并以保罗·施拉德执导的《陌生人的慰藉》闭幕。

en.s: The 1992 West Virginia Democratic presidential primary was held on May 10, 1992, in the state of West Virginia as one of the Democratic Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 1992 presidential election. Bill Clinton comfortably won the contest by a 62-point margin.

zh.t: 1992年西弗吉尼亚州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 1992年西弗吉尼亚州民主党总统初选于1992年5月10日举行，是民主党在1992年总统大选前举行的州级提名选举之一。比尔·克林顿以62个百分点的优势轻松获胜。

en.s: The 1991–92 FA Trophy Final, known as the 1992 Vauxhall FA Trophy Final for sponsorship reasons, was the final match of the 1991–92 FA Trophy. It was the 23rd season of the competition for teams from the Conference and other semi-professional teams below this level. The match was held on 10 May 1992 at Wembley Stadium, London, and was contested by Colchester United and Witton Albion.

zh.s: 1991—92赛季足总锦标赛决赛因赞助冠名称为1992年Vauxhall足总锦标赛决赛，是该赛季赛事的最后一场比赛，也是这项面向英格兰足球联赛第五至第八级别球队及其他半职业球队的第23届赛事。比赛于1992年5月10日在伦敦温布利球场举行，对阵双方是科尔切斯特联和威顿阿尔比恩。

en.s: The 1992 Soviet Cup final was a football match that took place at the Luzhniki Stadium, Moscow, on 10 May 1992. The Soviet Union was in the process of being dismantled with all organizations such as the Football Federation of the Soviet Union abandoned. Therefore, the game was administered by the Russian Football Union. The match was the 51st Soviet Cup Final and it was contested by FC Spartak Moscow and PFC CSKA Moscow.

zh.s: 1992年苏联杯决赛于1992年5月10日在莫斯科卢日尼基体育场举行。苏联当时正处于解体过程中，苏联足球协会等机构已停止运作，因此比赛由俄罗斯足球联盟组织。这是第51届苏联杯决赛，由莫斯科斯巴达克和莫斯科中央陆军交锋。

en.s: The Kader Toy Factory fire occurred on 10 May 1993 at a factory in Thailand. It is considered the worst industrial factory fire in history. 188 people were killed, and over 500 were seriously injured. Most of the victims were young female workers from rural families. More people were killed than in the Triangle Shirtwaist Factory fire; despite this, the incident received little media attention outside Thailand. The factory was owned by the Charoen Pokphand (CP) Group, a Thai transnational corporation and one of Asia's largest agribusiness firms.

zh.s: 1993年5月10日，泰国卡德玩具厂发生火灾，被认为是史上最严重的工厂火灾。事故造成188人死亡、500多人重伤。大多数遇难者是来自农村家庭的年轻女性工人。死亡人数超过1911年的三角衬衫厂火灾，但这起事故在泰国以外很少受到媒体关注。工厂由泰国跨国企业正大集团所有，该集团是亚洲最大农业综合企业之一。

en.s: The 1994 election for Mayor of Newark took place in Newark, the most populous city in the state of New Jersey, on May 10, 1994. Elections for all seats on the nine-member Municipal Council of Newark were held the same day. A runoff election, if necessary, would have taken place. Elections in the city are non-partisan and candidates are not listed by political party.

zh.s: 纽瓦克市长选举于1994年5月10日在新泽西州人口最多的城市纽瓦克举行。同日还举行了纽瓦克市九人市议会的全部席位选举。如有需要，原本还会举行决选。该市选举不设党派，候选人名单上也不标注党派。

en.t: Nelson Mandela is inaugurated as South Africa's first black president
en.s: Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela (18 July 1918 – 5 December 2013) was a South African anti-apartheid revolutionary, politician, and philanthropist, who served as President of South Africa from 1994 to 1999. He was the country's first black head of state and the first elected in a fully representative democratic election. His government focused on dismantling the legacy of apartheid by tackling institutionalised racism and fostering racial reconciliation.

zh.t: 纳尔逊·曼德拉就任南非首位黑人总统
zh.s: 纳尔逊·罗利赫拉赫拉·曼德拉（1918 年 7 月 18 日—2013 年 12 月 5 日）是南非反种族隔离革命家、政治家和慈善家，1994 至 1999 年担任南非总统。他是南非首位黑人国家元首，也是该国首次在充分代表制民主选举中选出的总统。他的政府致力于消除种族隔离的影响，包括处理制度性种族主义、推动种族和解。

en.s: The 1995 UEFA Cup Winners' Cup final was a football match on 10 May 1995 contested between cup holders Arsenal of England and Zaragoza of Aragon. The final was held at Parc des Princes in Paris. It was the final match of the 1994–95 UEFA Cup Winners' Cup, 35th UEFA Cup Winners' Cup final, and the first since the tournament changed name from the European Cup Winners' Cup.

zh.s: 1995年欧洲优胜者杯决赛于1995年5月10日举行，由卫冕冠军、英格兰阿森纳对阵阿拉贡的萨拉戈萨。比赛在巴黎王子公园球场举行，是1994—95赛季欧洲优胜者杯的最后一场比赛，也是第35届决赛。赛事更名为欧洲优胜者杯后，这是首届以新名称举行的决赛。

en.s: On 10–11 May 1996, eight climbers were caught in a blizzard and died on Mount Everest while attempting to descend from the summit. Over that season, 12 people died trying to reach the summit. These deaths marked that season the deadliest season on Mount Everest until it became the third deadliest after the 23 fatalities from avalanches caused by the April 2015 Nepal earthquake and the 16 fatalities of the 2014 Mount Everest avalanche.

zh.s: 1996年5月10日至11日，八名登山者在珠穆朗玛峰遭遇暴风雪，尝试从峰顶下撤时遇难。该登山季共有12人攀登珠峰时死亡。在2015年4月尼泊尔地震引发雪崩造成23人死亡、2014年珠峰雪崩造成16人死亡之前，这些遇难者使1996年成为珠峰登山史上死亡人数最多的一个登山季；此后则排第三。

en.s: The 1997 Coupe de France final was a football match held at the Parc des Princes, Paris on 10 May 1997, that saw Nice defeat Guingamp in a penalty shoot out. After normal time and extra-time could not separate the two sides, the match was to be decided on penalty kicks. Stéphane Carnot and Claude Michel missed for Guingamp, while only Louis Gomis missed for Nice.

zh.s: 1997年法国杯决赛于1997年5月10日在巴黎王子公园球场举行。尼斯队在点球大战中击败甘冈队。双方在常规时间和加时赛中均未分胜负，比赛因此进入点球决胜。甘冈队的斯特凡·卡尔诺和克洛德·米歇尔罚失点球；尼斯队只有路易·戈米斯罚失。

en.s: Chapter 2 was a professional wrestling live event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW) on May 10, 1997. The event was held in the ECW Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania in the United States. Excerpts from Chapter 2 aired on episode #212 of the syndicated television show ECW Hardcore TV on May 15, 1997.

zh.s: “第二章”是一场由极限冠军摔角（ECW）主办的职业摔角现场赛事，于1997年5月10日在美国宾夕法尼亚州费城的ECW体育馆举行。赛事片段于1997年5月15日在联合发行的电视节目《ECW硬核电视》第212集中播出。

en.s: An earthquake struck northern Iran's Khorasan Province in the vicinity of Qaen on May 10, 1997, at 07:57 UTC (12:57 local time). The largest in the area since 1990, the earthquake registered 7.3 on the moment magnitude scale and was centered approximately 270 kilometers (170 mi) south of Mashhad on the village of Ardekul. The third earthquake that year to cause severe damage, it devastated the Birjand–Qayen region, killing 1,567 and injuring more than 2,300.

zh.s: 1997年5月10日，伊朗北部呼罗珊省盖恩附近于世界协调时07:57（当地时间12:57）发生地震。这是该地区自1990年以来最强的一次地震，矩震级为7.3，震中位于马什哈德以南约270公里（170英里）的阿尔德库勒村附近。这是当年造成严重破坏的第三场地震，重创比尔詹德—盖恩地区，造成1,567人死亡、逾2,300人受伤。

en.s: General elections were held in Paraguay on 10 May 1998. The presidential elections were won by Raúl Cubas Grau of the Colorado Party, who received 55.3% of the vote. In the Congressional elections, the Colorado Party won 45 of the 80 seats in the Chamber of Deputies and 24 of the 45 seats in the Senate, defeating the Democratic Alliance formed by the Authentic Radical Liberal Party and the National Encounter Party.

zh.s: 1998年5月10日，巴拉圭举行大选。红党候选人劳尔·库巴斯·格劳赢得总统选举，得票率为55.3%。在国会选举中，红党赢得80个众议院席位中的45席，以及45个参议院席位中的24席，击败了由真正激进自由党和全国相遇党组成的民主联盟。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Hungary on 10 May 1998, with a second round of voting in 175 of the 176 single member constituencies on 24 May. Although the Hungarian Socialist Party received the most votes, Fidesz won the most seats. The successful breakthrough into parliament by the extreme right-wing Hungarian Justice and Life Party was also a major shock.

zh.s: 匈牙利于1998年5月10日举行议会选举。176个单一席位选区中的175个于5月24日举行第二轮投票。匈牙利社会党得票最多，但青民盟赢得的席位最多。极右翼的匈牙利正义与生活党成功进入议会，也令各方大感意外。

en.s: The 2000 Greek Cup final was the 56th final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 10 May 2000 at the Olympic Stadium. The contesting teams were AEK Athens and Ionikos. It was AEK Athens' sixteenth Greek Cup final in their 76 years of existence and Ionikos' first-ever Greek Cup final of their 35-year history.

zh.s: 2000年希腊杯决赛是第56届希腊杯决赛，于2000年5月10日在奥林匹克体育场举行。对阵双方是雅典AEK和伊奥尼科斯。这是雅典AEK在队史76年间第16次打进希腊杯决赛，也是伊奥尼科斯在队史35年间首次闯入决赛。

en.s: The twelfth legislative assembly election of Tamil Nadu was held on May 10, 2001. All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (ADMK)-led front won the elections and its leader, J. Jayalalithaa was sworn in as Chief Minister, even though she could not legally run as MLA in this election. She was unanimously nominated as Chief Minister by her party and was ready to serve her second term.

zh.t: 2001年泰米尔纳德邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 泰米尔纳德邦第十二届立法议会选举于2001年5月10日举行。全印度安纳达罗毗荼进步联盟（ADMK）领导的阵营赢得选举。该党领袖J·贾亚拉利塔虽依法不能在本次选举中竞选邦议员，仍获党内一致提名为首席部长，并准备开始她的第二个任期。

en.s: The 2001 Kerala Legislative Assembly election was held on 10 May 2001 to elect members to the Kerala State Assembly. Polls were held simultaneously in all 140 seats and resulted in a voter turnout of 72.47%. The election saw a change of guard in the state with the United Democratic Front winning 99 seats as opposed to the 40 won by the Left Democratic Front.

zh.s: 2001年喀拉拉邦立法议会选举于5月10日举行，选出喀拉拉邦议会议员。140个席位同日进行投票，投票率为72.47%。邦内政权更替，团结民主阵线赢得99席，左翼民主阵线赢得40席。

en.s: Legislative Assembly elections were held in Indian state of West Bengal in 2001 to elect 294 members of the West Bengal Legislative Assembly.

zh.s: 西孟加拉邦于2001年举行立法议会选举，改选邦议会全部294个席位。

en.s: Elections to the Assam Legislative Assembly were held in 2001 to elect members of 114 constituencies in Assam, India. The Indian National Congress won the popular vote and a majority of seats and Tarun Gogoi was appointed as the Chief Minister of Assam. The number of constituencies was set as 126, by the recommendation of the Delimitation Commission of India.

zh.s: 阿萨姆邦于2001年举行立法议会选举，改选114个选区的议员。印度国大党赢得最多选票和多数席位，塔伦·戈戈伊随后获任阿萨姆邦首席部长。根据印度划界委员会的建议，选区数量确定为126个。

en.s: UFC 37: High Impact was a mixed martial arts event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship at the CenturyTel Center in Bossier City, Louisiana on May 10, 2002. The event was seen live on pay per view in the United States, and was later released on home video.

zh.s: UFC 37：高强度是一场终极格斗冠军赛综合格斗赛事，于2002年5月10日在路易斯安那州博西尔城的世纪电信中心举行。赛事在美国通过付费电视直播，之后发行了家庭录像。

en.s: Operation Defensive Shield (Hebrew: מִבְצָע חוֹמַת מָגֵן Mīvtzāh Ḥōmat Māgēn) was a 2002 Israeli military operation in the Israeli-occupied West Bank during the Second Intifada. Lasting for just over a month, it was the largest combat operation in the territory since the 1967 Arab–Israeli War. The operation began with an Israeli incursion into Ramallah, where Yasser Arafat was placed under siege at his compound.

zh.s: 防御盾牌行动（希伯来语：מִבְצָע חוֹמַת מָגֵן，Mīvtzāh Ḥōmat Māgēn）是以色列于2002年在被占领的约旦河西岸开展的一次军事行动，发生于第二次巴勒斯坦大起义期间。行动持续了一个多月，是1967年阿以战争以来该地区规模最大的战斗行动。行动始于以军进入拉姆安拉，围困亚西尔·阿拉法特所在的驻地。

en.t: Siege of the Church of the Nativity
en.s: From 2 April to 10 May 2002, the Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem in the West Bank was besieged by the Israel Defense Forces (IDF), targeting suspected Palestinian militants who had taken shelter in the church. As part of Operation Defensive Shield, the IDF occupied Bethlehem and attempted to capture suspected Palestinian militants. Dozens of them fled into the Church of the Nativity and sought refuge.

en.s: There have been four railway accidents at Potters Bar in England. Those in 1898 and 1946 were signals passed at danger. The accident in 2002 led to substantial public debate and a national change in policy relating to maintenance of infrastructure.

zh.s: 英国波特斯巴发生过四起铁路事故。1898年和1946年的两起事故均与列车闯过停止信号有关。2002年的事故引发了广泛公共讨论，并促使全国改变基础设施维护政策。

en.s: The 2003 Football Conference play-off final took place on 10 May 2003 and was contested between Dagenham & Redbridge and Doncaster Rovers. It was held at the Britannia Stadium, Stoke-on-Trent and was the inaugural final of the Football Conference playoffs which were introduced to accommodate a second promotion place to the Football League.

zh.t: 2003年足球议会联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2003年足球议会联赛升级附加赛决赛于2003年5月10日举行，由达根汉姆和雷德布里奇对阵唐卡斯特流浪者。比赛在特伦特河畔斯托克的布里塔尼亚球场举行。这是足球议会联赛首次举行附加赛决赛，赛事旨在增设一个升入足球联赛的名额。

en.s: Presidential elections, legislative elections and local elections were held in the Philippines on May 10, 2004. In the presidential election, incumbent president Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo won a full six-year term as president, with a margin of just over one million votes over her leading opponent, highly popular movie actor Fernando Poe, Jr.. The elections were notable for several reasons. This election first saw the implementation of the Overseas Absentee Voting Act of 2003 (see Wikisource), which enabled Filipinos in over 70 countries to vote. This is also the first election since the 1986 People Power Revolution where an incumbent president ran in the presidential election.

zh.s: 2004年5月10日，菲律宾举行总统、立法机构和地方选举。时任总统格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔-阿罗约胜出，获得完整的六年总统任期，比主要对手、知名电影演员费尔南多·坡多出略多于100万票。本次选举有多项特点：菲律宾首次实施2003年《海外缺席投票法》，让70多个国家的菲律宾人能够投票；也是1986年人民力量革命以来，首次有时任总统参选总统。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in India in four phases between 20 April and 10 May 2004. Over 670 million people were eligible to vote, electing 543 members of the 14th Lok Sabha. The Lok Sabha, or "House of the People," is the directly elected lower house of the Parliament of India. On 13 May, the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and its alliance National Democratic Alliance conceded defeat. The Indian National Congress, which had governed India for all but five years from independence until 1996, returned to power after a record eight years out of office.

zh.s: 2004年4月20日至5月10日，印度分四阶段举行议会选举。超过6.7亿人有资格投票，选出第14届人民院543名议员。人民院又称“人民议院”，是印度议会由选举产生的下院。5月13日，执政的印度人民党（BJP）及其全国民主联盟承认败选。自印度独立到1996年间，除了五年外一直执政的印度国民大会党，在野八年后重新上台。

en.s: The Philippine presidential and vice presidential elections of 2004 was held on Monday, May 10, 2004. In the presidential election, incumbent president Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo won a full six-year term as President, with a margin of just over one million votes over her leading opponent, highly popular movie actor Fernando Poe, Jr.. The 3.48% margin of victory is the closest margin in Philippine presidential election history. The elections were notable for several reasons. This election first saw the implementation of the Overseas Absentee Voting Act of 2003 (see Wikisource), which enabled Filipinos in over 70 countries to vote.

zh.s: 2004年5月10日（星期一），菲律宾举行总统和副总统选举。根据1987年宪法，时任总统格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔-阿罗约不能寻求连任，因此本次选举将选出菲律宾第15任总统。时任副总统诺利·德卡斯特罗可以寻求连任，也可能竞选总统，但他最终没有以任何身份参选，因此新任副总统也由本次选举选出。总统和副总统分别选出，胜选者可能来自不同政党。阿罗约以略多于100万票的优势击败知名电影演员费尔南多·坡。她领先3.48个百分点，是菲律宾总统选举史上最接近的胜选差距。本次选举还首次实施2003年《海外缺席投票法》，允许70多个国家的菲律宾人投票。

en.s: The senatorial election was held in the Philippines on May 10, 2004. The major coalitions that participated are the Koalisyon ng Katapatan at Karanasan sa Kinabukasan (K4; Coalition of Truth and Experience for Tomorrow) composed of parties that support the candidacy of president Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo, and the Koalisyon ng Nagkakaisang Pilipino (KNP; Coalition of United Filipinos), parties that support the candidacy of movie actor Fernando Poe Jr. A third coalition, the Alyansa ng Pag-asa (Alliance of Hope) was made up of Aksyon Demokratiko and Reporma-LM. K4 won seven seats, while the KNP won the remaining five contested seats in the Philippine Senate.

zh.s: 2004年5月10日，菲律宾举行参议员选举。主要参选联盟包括支持总统格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔-阿罗约的“K4”（Koalisyon ng Katapatan at Karanasan sa Kinabukasan，意为“真诚与经验联盟”），以及支持电影演员费尔南多·坡的“菲律宾人团结联盟”（KNP）。另有由民主行动党和改革派—自由意志运动组成的“希望联盟”。K4赢得七席，KNP赢得其余五个改选席位。

en.s: The Sikkim Legislative Assembly election, 2004 took place on 10 May 2004 for 32 members of the Sikkim Legislative Assembly. Counting and result was declared on 13 May 2004. Sikkim Democratic Front won 31 of the 32 assembly seats in this election which is a regional political party.

zh.s: 锡金邦立法议会选举于2004年5月10日举行，选出32名议员。计票和结果于2004年5月13日公布。地方政党锡金民主阵线赢得32个席位中的31席。

en.s: The Elections for the House of Representatives of the Philippines were held on May 10, 2004. Being held together with presidential election, the party of the incumbent president Gloria Macapagal Arroyo, Lakas-Christian Muslim Democrats, and by extension the administration-led coalition, the Koalisyon ng Katapatan at Karanasan sa Kinabukasan (K4), won majority of the seats in the House of Representatives.

zh.s: 菲律宾众议院选举于2004年5月10日举行，与总统选举同时进行。现任总统格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔·阿罗约所属的基督教穆斯林民主力量党，以及由该党领导的执政联盟“国家未来忠诚与经验联盟”（K4），赢得众议院多数席位。

en.t: 2004 Indian general election in Uttar Pradesh
en.s: The 2004 Indian general election in Uttar Pradesh were held between 26 April and 10 May 2004 for the 14th Lok Sabha. The election results were declared on 13 May in which the national parties the BJP and the Congress performed quite badly while the state parties, SP and BSP did very well and fetched majority of the seats.

zh.s: 2004年印度第十四届人民院选举在北方邦的投票于4月26日至5月10日举行。选举结果于5月13日公布。全国性政党印度人民党和国大党表现不佳，而邦级政党社会党和巴胡詹社会党表现强劲，赢得多数席位。

en.s: Local elections were held in Manila on May 10, 2004, within the Philippine general election. The voters elected the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, the six Congressmen, and the councilors, six in each of the city's six legislative districts. Incumbent Mayor Lito Atienza of Liberal forged an alliance with Don Ramon Bagatsing, who is the leader of Laban ng Demokratikong Pilipino (LDP) Manila chapter.

zh.s: 2004年5月10日，马尼拉举行地方选举，与菲律宾大选同期进行。选民选出市长、副市长、六名国会议员，以及六个国会选区各自的六名市议员。现任市长、自由党人利托·阿蒂恩萨与拉班民主党马尼拉分部领袖唐·拉蒙·巴加辛结成联盟。

en.s: The 2004 Indian general election in Punjab was held on 13 seats of Lok Sabha in April to May 2004 and elections were held in the 4th Phase on 10th May 2004 for all the 13 constituencies. The members were elected for the 14th Lok Sabha.

zh.s: 2004年4月至5月，印度举行大选，旁遮普邦改选人民院的13个席位。该邦全部13个选区于2004年5月10日、第四阶段投票时进行选举，选出第十四届人民院议员。

en.t: 2004 Indian general election in West Bengal
en.s: The 2004 Indian general election were held in Indian state West Bengal in 2004 to elect all 42 seats of Lok Sabha in the state. The election took place on 10 May 2004 and a turnout of 77.7% was recorded. The Communist Party of India (Marxist) led Left Front had an overwhelming victory in the state by winning 35 seats.

zh.t: 2004年印度大选西孟加拉邦选举
zh.s: 2004年印度大选期间，西孟加拉邦改选人民院的全部42个席位。投票于2004年5月10日举行，投票率为77.7%。印度共产党（马克思主义）领导的左翼阵线在该邦大获全胜，赢得35席。

en.s: Local elections were held in Cebu City on May 10, 2004, within the Philippine general election. Registered voters of the city elected candidates for the following elective local posts: mayor, vice mayor, district representatives, and eight councilors for each district. There are two legislative districts in the city.

zh.s: 2004年5月10日，宿务市举行地方选举，与菲律宾大选同期进行。该市登记选民选出市长、副市长、各选区代表，以及每个选区的八名市议员。宿务市共有两个国会选区。

en.s: Election to the Senate of the Philippines was held on Monday, May 10, 2010. This is to elect 12 of the 24 seats in the Senate. Together with those elected in 2007, they will comprise the 15th Congress. The senators elected in 2007 will serve until June 30, 2013, while the senators elected in this election will serve up to June 30, 2016. The 2010 presidential election, elections to the House of Representatives as well as local elections will occur on the same date. The Philippines uses plurality-at-large voting for seats in the Senate: the twelve candidates with the highest amount of votes wins the twelve seats up for election.

en.s: The Philippine presidential and vice presidential elections of 2010 were held on Monday, May 10, 2010. The ruling President of the Philippines, Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo, was barred from seeking re-election by the 1987 Constitution, thus necessitating an election to select the 15th President. Incumbent Vice-President Noli de Castro was allowed to seek re-election though he could have possibly sought the presidency. As he didn't offer himself in any manner of candidacy at the election, his successor was determined as the 15th Vice President of the Philippines. Although most presidential candidates have running mates, the president and vice president are elected separately, and the winning candidates may be of different political parties.

zh.s: 2010年5月10日（星期一），菲律宾举行总统和副总统选举。根据1987年宪法，时任总统格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔-阿罗约不得寻求连任，因此选举选出菲律宾第15任总统。时任副总统诺利·德卡斯特罗可以竞选连任，也可能竞选总统，但他没有报名参选，副总统职位也因此由本次选举决定。虽然多数总统候选人有竞选搭档，总统和副总统仍分别选出，胜选者可能来自不同政党。

en.s: Gubernatorial elections was held in the Philippines on May 10, 2010. All provinces elected their provincial governors for three-year terms that will begin on June 30, 2010. Governors that are currently serving their third consecutive terms are prohibited from running as governors (they may run in any other position). Highly urbanized cities and independent component cities such as Zamboanga City, Angeles and Cebu City, and including Metro Manila and the municipality of Pateros are outside the jurisdiction of any province and thus won't elect for governors of their mother provinces (Pampanga and Cebu, for Angeles and Cebu City).

zh.s: 2010年5月10日，菲律宾各省举行省长选举，选出任期三年的省长，任期从2010年6月30日开始。已连续担任三届的现任省长不得竞选连任，但可以竞选其他职位。高度城市化城市和独立组成市不属于任何省的管辖范围，因此不为其所在省选省长；这些地区包括三宝颜市、安赫莱斯市、宿务市、马尼拉大都会和帕特罗斯市。

en.s: The 2011 North Miami mayoral election took place on May 10, 2011. Incumbent Mayor Andre Pierre, who was first elected in 2009, ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by attorney Carol Keys and former City Councilman Jacques Despinosse. Pierre, whose profile was raised after the 2010 Haiti earthquake as he emerged as an advocate for Haitian Americans, faced controversy over city spending and corruption allegations.

zh.s: 北迈阿密市长选举于2011年5月10日举行。2009年首次当选的现任市长安德烈·皮埃尔竞选连任，争取第二个任期。律师卡罗尔·基斯和前市议员雅克·德斯皮诺斯向他发起挑战。2010年海地地震后，皮埃尔因倡导海地裔美国人的权益而受到关注；此后，他也因市政开支和腐败指控陷入争议。

en.s: The 2011 Welsh Conservatives leadership election was held on 14 July 2011. Andrew RT Davies defeated Nick Ramsay, the only other candidate. Following the 2011 Assembly election the party's leader Nick Bourne lost his Mid and West Wales seat. Paul Davies then became the interim leader whilst an election took place. The contest then consisted of Andrew RT Davies (South Wales Central) against Ramsay (Monmouth).

en.s: The 10 May 2012 Damascus bombings were carried out using a pair of car bombs allegedly detonated by suicide bombers outside of a military intelligence complex in Damascus, Syria. Combined, the perpetrators detonated more than 1,000 kilograms (2,200 lb) of explosives, tearing the facade off a 10-story building. With 55 people confirmed dead and almost 400 others injured, the attack was the deadliest bombing to its date in the Syrian Civil War, though later outpaced by other events.

zh.s: 2012年5月10日，大马士革发生爆炸案。两辆汽车炸弹据称由自杀式袭击者在叙利亚大马士革一处军事情报机构建筑群外引爆。袭击者引爆的炸药总量超过1,000公斤（2,200磅），炸毁了一栋10层建筑的外墙。已确认55人死亡，近400人受伤。这是叙利亚内战截至当时伤亡最惨重的爆炸袭击，后来才被其他事件超过。

en.s: Global Wars was a professional wrestling supershow co-produced by the American Ring of Honor (ROH) and Japanese New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) promotions. The event took place on May 10, 2014, at the Ted Reeve Arena in Toronto, Ontario, Canada and aired live on internet pay-per-view (iPPV) through Ustream. The event was originally billed as "Border Wars", a name ROH had used for events in 2012 and 2013. With the exception of one interpromotional match, wrestlers from NJPW and ROH were kept separated from each other with the bookers from each promotion handling their own half of the show.

zh.s: Global Wars是美国荣誉摔角联盟（ROH）和日本新日本职业摔角（NJPW）联合制作的大型职业摔角赛事，于2014年5月10日在加拿大安大略省多伦多的泰德·里夫竞技场举行，并通过Ustream网络付费直播。赛事最初名为“边境战争”，这是ROH于2012年和2013年使用过的名称。除一场跨联盟比赛外，新日本和荣誉摔角联盟的选手分开参赛，双方各自的订赛团队负责安排自己一半的节目。

en.s: UFC Fight Night: Miocic vs. Hunt (also known as UFC Fight Night 65) was a mixed martial arts event held on 10 May 2015 at the Adelaide Entertainment Centre in Adelaide, Australia.

zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：米奥契奇对亨特（又称UFC格斗之夜第65期）是一场综合格斗赛事，于2015年5月10日在澳大利亚阿德莱德的阿德莱德娱乐中心举行。

en.s: Uruguay held local government elections on May 10, 2015, electing the intendente of the 19 departments that are the administrative divisions of Uruguay, as well as 112 local governments. This was the second time that both intendentes and alcaldes were elected simultaneously.

zh.s: 乌拉圭于2015年5月10日举行地方选举，选出该国19个行政区的行政长官，以及112个地方政府的负责人。这是行政区长官与市长第二次同时选举。

en.s: The 2015 Bremen state election was held on 10 May 2015 to elect the members of the Bürgerschaft of Bremen, as well as the city councils of Bremen and Bremerhaven. The incumbent government of the Social Democratic Party (SPD) and The Greens retained its majority. However, Mayor and SPD leader Jens Böhrnsen resigned due to his party's poor performance, which was significantly below expectations.

zh.s: 不来梅州于2015年5月10日举行选举，选出不来梅州议会以及不来梅和不来梅哈芬市议会的议员。由社会民主党（SPD）和绿党组成的现任政府保住多数席位。不过，社民党表现远低于预期，党魁、州长延斯·伯恩森因此辞职。

en.s: A series of shootouts erupted during a raid between the Macedonian police and an armed group identifying itself as the National Liberation Army (NLA). They began on 9 May 2015 in the northern Macedonian town of Kumanovo, and ended the following day on 10 May. During the shootings, 8 Macedonian policemen and 14 of the militants were killed, while 37 officers were wounded and hospitalized.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2015年5月9日，马其顿北部城市库马诺沃发生突袭，马其顿警方与一支自称“民族解放军”（NLA）的武装团体发生一系列枪战。冲突于次日5月10日结束。枪战造成8名马其顿警察和14名武装人员死亡，另有37名警员受伤并送医。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Poland on 10 and 24 May 2015. In the first round of voting Law and Justice (PiS) candidate, lawyer and Member of the European Parliament, Andrzej Duda received the highest number of votes with a share of 34.76%, followed by the incumbent president Bronisław Komorowski (with 33.77%), who ran as an independent with the endorsement of the Civic Platform (PO), whose membership he had renounced after winning the 2010 elections.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 波兰总统选举于2015年5月10日和24日举行。第一轮投票中，法律与公正党（PiS）候选人、律师和欧洲议会议员安杰伊·杜达得票最多，得票率为34.76%。现任总统布罗尼斯瓦夫·科莫罗夫斯基以33.77%紧随其后。他以独立候选人身份参选，并获公民纲领党（PO）支持；他在2010年当选后已退出该党。
zh.n: 本条记录的是来源信息框所列的第一轮投票日期。

en.s: The 2016 Croatian Cup final was a one-legged affair played between Dinamo Zagreb and Slaven Belupo. The final was played in Osijek on 10 May 2016.

zh.s: 2016年克罗地亚杯决赛采用单场决胜制，由萨格勒布迪纳摩对阵斯拉文贝鲁波。决赛于2016年5月10日在奥西耶克举行。

en.s: The 2016 Nebraska Republican presidential primary was held on May 10 in the U.S. state of Nebraska as one of the Republican Party's primaries ahead of the 2016 presidential election. The only candidate on the ballot who did not withdraw was Donald Trump. The Libertarian Party held their own Nebraska primary on the same day. The Democratic Party held their Nebraska caucuses on March 5.

zh.t: 2016年内布拉斯加州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2016年5月10日，内布拉斯加州举行共和党总统初选，是该党在2016年总统大选前举行的初选之一。选票上唯一未退选的候选人是唐纳德·特朗普。自由党也在当天举行了内布拉斯加州初选；民主党则于3月5日举行党团会议。

en.s: The 2016 West Virginia Democratic presidential primary was held on May 10 in the U.S. state of West Virginia as one of the Democratic Party's primaries ahead of the 2016 presidential election. The Republican Party held primaries in two states, including their own West Virginia primary, while for the Democratic Party this was the only primary on that day.

zh.t: 2016年西弗吉尼亚州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2016年5月10日，西弗吉尼亚州举行民主党总统初选，是该党在2016年总统大选前举行的初选之一。当天，共和党在两个州举行初选，其中包括西弗吉尼亚州；民主党当天只在该州举行了这一场初选。

en.s: The 2016 West Virginia Republican presidential primary was held on May 10 in the U.S. state of West Virginia as one of the Republican Party's primaries ahead of the 2016 presidential election. The only candidate on the ballot who had not withdrawn was Donald Trump. Both the Democratic Party and the Libertarian Party hold their own West Virginia primaries on the same day.

zh.t: 2016年西弗吉尼亚州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2016年5月10日，西弗吉尼亚州举行共和党总统初选，是该党在2016年总统大选前举行的初选之一。选票上唯一未退选的候选人是唐纳德·特朗普。民主党和自由党也在当天分别举行了西弗吉尼亚州初选。
